release_notes:
Vortex PT v1.1.1:
• Stressing Jack Tail Elongation Deduction (Ljack): Added fully integrated option to deduct elastic strand elongation occurring inside the stressing jack body (Hooke's Law: dL = P_target * Ljack / (Ap * Ep)) for ASTM A416 Grade 270 12.7mm (0.5") and 15.2mm (0.6") strands.
• Exact Technical Standard: At 1.0m jack internal tail length, standard 12.7mm strand deducts 7.2mm at 75% load (137.7 kN) and 7.6mm at 80% load (146.9 kN) per live stressing end.
• Universal Propagation: Automatically updates schedules, tables, CAD plan callouts, and drawing general notes (Note 6) with both gross and net elongation values tracked.
